impact: The W03 cold measurement can include a hidden derived cache write and can be nearly doubled at 16 rows. The clean-root test is not sufficient for the frozen no-policy claim.
minimal_owner_action: Clear RAWLSING_C11_ACCELERATOR_POLICY and RAWLSING_C11_ACCELERATOR_DIR in cold children (or otherwise reject/observe actual policy activation), detect the actual policy root and any write, and add an inherited-policy cold test. Do not treat base-root derived_cache_files=0 as proof of no policy.
observed: Clean cold 16 reports derived_cache_files=0, canonical_files=None, derived_status=NO_GOVERNED_DERIVED_CACHE_WRITE, cold_metric=56,971,264 B, process_peak=56,983,552 B. With a valid inherited RAWLSING_C11_ACCELERATOR_POLICY, the same 16-row cold run reports the same zero derived/canonical status but writes env_policy/derived-accelerator/c11-events-f.parquet (22,412 B); cold_metric rises to 102,768,640 B and process_peak to 102,780,928 B. The facade attaches governed cache for ExactPhysicalCellStream and reads the policy env; _run_child copies the environment; the cold path does not clear the policy/legacy env.
remaining_final_obligation: Recheck clean cold at the pinned final SHA; final W03 receipt must have no actual policy-derived writes.
title: Inherited accelerator policy can still write a derived cache during the cold/no-policy scenario

impact: No method residual required at this boundary; final-scale sampling behavior remains a final obligation.
minimal_owner_action: None beyond final-scale reproduction of the corrected method.
observed: _stage records entry/exit OS current RSS, a 50 ms current-RSS sampled peak, and process ru_maxrss separately; aliases are labelled combined rather than zero. The focused test file passes 13 tests, including the post-highwater allocation test. Both arms use the same sampler.
title: Stage current RSS, sampled stage peak and process cumulative peak are now separated

impact: A final 100k result could be accepted while the monitor is unavailable or has no relevant cap evidence; the 8 MiB test does not prove the required authorized bound at scale.
minimal_owner_action: Add cap_enforced, cap_peak_sampled_bytes and cap_bytes requirements to final gate; reject unmonitored/over-cap/blocked runs. State the monitor kill as a sampled bound with overshoot; if the required bound cannot be enforced, emit BLOCKED_EXACT_DEPENDENCY. Keep the 8 MiB falsifier as a falsifier, not whole proof.
observed: The parent kill monitor blocks an 8 MiB run with cap_enforced=true, cap_peak_sampled_bytes=15,986,688, status=BLOCKED_EXACT_DEPENDENCY. The acceptance gate keys contain no cap_enforced/cap_peak_sampled_bytes/cap_bytes; a synthetic selected-metrics result passes the gate without cap evidence. On success cap_enforced=sampled (at least one sample), not proof of the required bound. The 8 MiB falsifier is not a 100k guarantee.
remaining_final_obligation: Final 100k run must demonstrate active monitor and bounded sampling; no whole PASS otherwise.
title: Cap falsifier passes at 8 MiB, but acceptance does not require cap enforcement or cap peak evidence

impact: A legitimate final candidate with a justified/corrected non-selected profile regression could be rejected by an invented stricter gate; the gate does not encode the frozen correction semantics.
minimal_owner_action: Record >10% other-profile RSS/wall regressions explicitly and require a correction/justification field for pass; do not make every regression an automatic failure. Keep the selected cold-wide 15% and repeat 90% thresholds.
observed: `pass_all = ... and not regressions`; the regression loop marks every cold/full-matrix profile with >10% RSS or wall regression and therefore fails. A synthetic 20% cold-narrow regression fails the gate even when the selected cold-wide and warm-repeat metrics are satisfactory. The frozen W03 positive requires other profiles and wall regressions to be explicitly reported, with any >10% regression requiring justified correction, not an automatic universal pass ban.
remaining_final_obligation: Final gate must use the frozen report/correction semantics; no 64-row pass.
title: Acceptance invents a universal >10% profile-regression ban instead of report plus justified correction

impact: The W34 repeat metric is not the frozen restart-to-first-consumer metric; canonical post-first-consumer work can inflate the ratio and cause a false fail (or obscure the actual first-consumer economics). The 64-row RED remains diagnostic, but it is not measured on the contracted clock.
minimal_owner_action: Instrument a parent-start-to-first-consumer clock (startup plus normal derived first consumer), use it for both current warm and protected no-acceleration cold baseline, and keep canonical reopen/parity in a separate correctness stage. Re-run small; final 100k uses the same clock.
observed: The gate uses median_parent_wall_seconds. In the 64-row repeat warm raw receipt, current parent=2.723282 s, firstconsumer=0.122029 s, canonical_reopen=0.687796 s; baseline cold repeat parent=1.881863 s, firstconsumer=0.125453 s. The current warm child runs the normal derived consumer first and then canonical reopen/canonical consumer; the 1.447 ratio includes work after the first consumer, contrary to the correction matrix statement that the comparison is not canonical reopen.
remaining_final_obligation: Final W34 receipt must report exact startup-to-first-consumer wall for both arms.
title: Warm economic clock uses whole-process parent wall including canonical reopen/consumer, not startup-to-first-consumer

impact: A baseline with changed event material or a copied/edited command/hash could pass identity; the final gate is not exact baseline identity.
minimal_owner_action: Add actual event counts and consumer fingerprint parity, exact command, and expected protected baseline file sha256 to identity; reject mismatch. Keep source/rows/profiles/repetitions/host checks and null-safe cold lookup.
observed: The gate identity checks schema, protected source head, rows, profiles, repetitions and host only. A synthetic baseline with these five fields but no actual_event_counts, command or sha256 passes the gate when selected metrics suffice. The raw parity/warm receipts contain event counts and consumer fingerprints, but the gate does not bind them. The output records baseline_identity.sha256 but compares it with nothing.
remaining_final_obligation: Final baseline must be the exact protected 4f method/host/profile/rows/events/repetitions/command/hash receipt.
title: Baseline identity omits actual event counts, command and expected baseline-file hash

impact: The reported write amortization understates actual cache-write cost and may misclassify benefit-aware retention.
minimal_owner_action: Separate and include derived write wall time (and bytes) in amortization, or explicitly label the figure canonical-only and add the derived component. Re-run small; final 100k.
observed: cache_write_amortization is canonical_persist_wall_seconds_total / len(warm_runs); warm_restarts_3 shows 0.204367/3=0.068122. The derived cache write is part of the W34 cache write but has no separate timed write; only canonical persist is amortized.
remaining_final_obligation: Final W34 write amortization must include actual derived and canonical writes.
title: Write amortization excludes derived-cache write cost

impact: A corrupted derived slot can be counted as an exact envelope/mtime hit, making canonical/derived cache economics and parity unreliable.
minimal_owner_action: Validate envelope/content identity (or actual cache read) before reporting a hit; add same-size/same-mtime corruption test; keep canonical reopen separate. Do not count metadata-only equality as a true cache hit.
observed: One byte of a derived parquet was flipped while preserving size 22,412 and mtime_ns 1794369225243866887. _build_release returned derived_hit=True, derived_write=False, status HIT_EXACT_ENVELOPE_AND_MTIME, same release_ref and event_count. The existing test corrupts with shorter bytes (size change), not same-size/same-mtime. The hit check compares only before/after name,size,mtime; it reads but does not compare the envelope/body identity.
remaining_final_obligation: Final derived/canonical hit evidence must prove content/envelope validity.
title: Same-size/same-mtime corrupt derived file is reported as HIT_EXACT_ENVELOPE_AND_MTIME
